purpose: Make tape-wrap candidate measurable without treating nominal catalogue thickness as maximum.
candidate_material: 3M 92; selection pending supplied-material and process verification

development_acceptance_targets.seam: Single wrap, overlap on upper broad face; no second full turn.

inspection: Measure representative supplied tape thickness under a defined repeatable low-force method; nominal catalogue value is insufficient.
Inspect raw joint for protruding strands and sharp solder; record width and height before wrapping.
Inspect whole wrapped lead, transition, joint and wire exit for exposed conductor and seam lifting.
Measure finished width/height without compressing the wrap; reject wrinkles that exceed the envelope.
Verify insulation after forming and assembled handling using a defined electrical test; test voltage and acceptance threshold still to be specified.
unresolved: Film-edge transition across supplied lead length tolerance
Tape overlap length and adhesion on tiny joint
Minimum retained collar and proof-load level
Actual solder profile and strand wicking
Bend fixture and repeated handling damage
boundary: Targets are proposed process limits, not manufacturer guarantees or evidence of producibility. Buyer performs none of these operations.

retention_dimension_screen.result: Small rectangular collar .3/.4 mm sections can avoid contact through .4 mm axial displacement in some sampled positions. Sections .5x.5 and larger contact in all sampled cases, but this is not a certified minimum because shape, deformation and escape paths are excluded.
retention_dimension_screen.next_step: Use actual finished joint cross-sections and all allowed movement limits before defining a lower acceptance bound; no minimum collar approved yet.
